description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and adding Orleans clients to different host builders in a .NET application, including methods that support fluent API design for integration with HostBuilder, HostApplicationBuilder, and service collections. It also defines a marker class for storing builder instances.

classes.name: OrleansBuilderMarker
classes.description: A marker class used for storing an Orleans IClientBuilder instance in a service collection to facilitate extension methods and builder management.

methods.name: UseOrleansClient
methods.description: Extension methods to configure and add an Orleans client to various host builders and service collections, supporting multiple overloads for flexibility.
